After about a decade of fighting for their freedom, one brother was acquitted by Pakistan’s Supreme Court on Oct. 7. The other brother, however, is still on death row. articlesAll.title: Africa: New campaign launched to help sub-Saharan Christians suffering persecution
articlesAll.summary: Open Doors UK has launched its Arise Africa campaign to raise awareness of violent persecution, displacement, and injustice affecting Christians across sub-Saharan Africa.

articlesAll.title: Open Doors calls for prayer for Syrian Christians following renewed violence
articlesAll.summary: Christian persecution charity Open Doors has appealed for prayers for believers in Syria following another armed attack on the predominantly Christian town of Al-Suqaylabiyah.
